name: Social Media Management
tagline: Consistent, on-brand content. Handled entirely by us.
description: Monthly content calendars, platform graphics, captions, and scheduling, fully managed under your agency's name. Your client stays active and on-brand without you spending an hour on it.

deliverables.title: Monthly Content Calendar
deliverables.description: A full month of planned posts (topics, formats, and posting schedule) delivered for your approval before anything goes live.

deliverables.title: Graphic Design
deliverables.description: On-brand static and carousel graphics for each platform. Sized correctly, visually consistent, client-approved.

deliverables.title: Caption Writing
deliverables.description: Platform-native captions written in the client's voice: hooks, body, hashtags, and CTAs included.

deliverables.title: Scheduling & Publishing
deliverables.description: Posts scheduled at optimal times for reach and engagement. We handle the publishing. Your client just shows up.

deliverables.title: Platform Management
deliverables.description: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, and TikTok. We manage whichever platforms your client needs.

deliverables.title: Monthly Performance Report
deliverables.description: Reach, engagement, follower growth, and top-performing content, white-labelled and ready to forward.

whyUs.title: Completely hands-off for you
whyUs.description: You approve the calendar once a month. We do everything else: design, write, schedule, and report. Your bandwidth stays free.

whyUs.title: Retainer stability for predictable revenue
whyUs.description: Social is a natural retainer service. Every client needs it every month. It's a reliable income stream that grows your MRR without adding complexity.

whyUs.title: Platform-native execution
whyUs.description: We don't repost the same content everywhere. Each platform gets content built for its format, audience, and algorithm.

faq.question: Which platforms do you manage?
faq.answer: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, and TikTok. Pick the platforms when you order, and your account manager can recommend the right mix for your client's audience.

faq.question: How does the approval process work?
faq.answer: We deliver a full monthly content calendar (posts, graphics, captions) for your review each month. You approve, request changes, or pass it straight to your client for sign-off. Nothing goes live without approval.

faq.question: Do you engage with comments and DMs?
faq.answer: Community management (responding to comments and DMs) is available as an add-on. By default, this retainer covers content creation and scheduling only.

faq.question: What do you need from us to get started?
faq.answer: Brand assets (logo, colours, fonts), existing content samples or tone notes, and platform access. You add these when you place the order, and your account manager confirms anything missing.

hero.ctaNote: 30 minutes with our founding team. No pitch deck, no pressure.

pains.sub: Social management is the easiest retainer to sell and the most relentless one to deliver — every day, every platform, in public.

pricing.sub: One flat management fee per platform, billed monthly. You set your client's retainer — and the margin renews every month the feed stays alive.

guarantees.title: Nothing posts without sign-off
guarantees.description: Every calendar and every post clears your approval before it reaches a public feed. No surprises under your client's name.

guarantees.title: Brand-safe by process
guarantees.description: Client guidelines enforced on every post, an instant pause process for sensitive days, and clear escalation if anything needs attention.

guarantees.title: White-label confidentiality
guarantees.description: Your brand on every calendar, report, and thread. Your client never learns we exist.

guarantees.title: No long-term lock-in

differentiators.sub: Fully managed under your name, platform-native execution, and retainer stability you can build revenue on.

faqExtra.question: Do you guarantee follower growth?
faqExtra.answer: No — and treat anyone who does with suspicion, because bought numbers are the only way to guarantee them. What we commit to: consistent, on-brand publishing, engagement-focused content, and honest monthly reporting on what's growing and why.

faqExtra.question: Who owns the social accounts?
faqExtra.answer: Your client, always. We work inside their accounts (or ones created in their name) — followers, content, and history stay theirs if they ever leave.

faqExtra.question: How fast can a new client go live?
faqExtra.answer: About a week from brand assets to the first approved calendar: voice and visual setup, a sample batch for your sign-off, then scheduled publishing begins. Rush onboarding is possible when a client is switching mid-month.

faqExtra.question: What if my client dislikes a post?
faqExtra.answer: It never gets that far — every post clears your approval before publishing. If tastes change after approval, revisions are quick and the calendar adjusts from the next batch.
